#!/bin/bash
BASE_URL="https://hf-mirror.com/Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B/resolve/main"
OUT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/models/qwen2.5-14b"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

download_file() {
    local fname="$1"
    local url="${BASE_URL}/${fname}"
    local out="${OUT_DIR}/${fname}"
    if [ -f "$out" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] $fname already exists"
        return 0
    fi
    echo "[START] $fname"
    wget -q -c -O "$out" "$url" && echo "[DONE] $fname" || echo "[FAIL] $fname"
}

# Download all 8 shards in parallel (4 at a time)
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
    fname=$(printf "model-%05d-of-00008.safetensors" $i)
    download_file "$fname" &
done
wait

for i in 5 6 7 8; do
    fname=$(printf "model-%05d-of-00008.safetensors" $i)
    download_file "$fname" &
done
wait

# Download remaining small files
for fname in tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json vocab.json; do
    if [ ! -f "${OUT_DIR}/${fname}" ]; then
        wget -q -c -O "${OUT_DIR}/${fname}" "${BASE_URL}/${fname}" 2>/dev/null
    fi
done

echo "ALL DOWNLOADS COMPLETE"
ls -lh "$OUT_DIR/"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/download_qwen14b.sh
echo "Script ready"
